title: Several forces on one object add up to a net force
summary: OpenStax Physics says multiple forces on one object combine into a net force, and that opposite pushes can cancel so nothing moves.
body: OpenStax Physics says that when multiple forces act on an object, the forces combine. Their sum is the net force. A teaching note asks what happens if more than one force is applied, and it describes two opposite pushes that can leave a heavy desk unmoved even though each push is real. One outcome can involve several forces at once. This card is that combining rule. It is not a numerical worksheet.
